questions.stem: Two identical thin rods of mass $M \text{ kg}$ and length $L \text{ m}$ are connected as shown in figure. Moment of inertia of the combined rod system about an axis passing through point $P$ and perpendicular to the plane of the rods is $\; \frac{x}{12} \text{ML}^2 \text{ kg} \text{ m}^2$. The value of $x$ is $\_\_\_\_$

image.alt: Figure for this Rotational Motion question

questions.solution:
Figure: T-shape; vertical rod hangs from $P$, horizontal rod's midpoint is joined at the lower end, a distance $L$ below $P$.
Vertical rod about its end: $I_1 = \frac{ML^2}{3} = \frac{4ML^2}{12}$
Horizontal rod: centre at distance $L$ from $P$; parallel axis theorem gives $I_2 = \frac{ML^2}{12} + ML^2 = \frac{13ML^2}{12}$
Total: $I = \frac{4+13}{12}ML^2 = \frac{17}{12}ML^2 \text{ kg m}^2$
So $x = 17$
Answer: 17
